title: About Capstone Vietnam
summary: A higher education consultancy founded in 2009, with offices in Hanoi and Ho Chi Minh City.
bodyHtml:
Capstone Vietnam is a human resource development company offering education and training solutions: institutional services, overseas study, skills training, English language testing and education products. Our first higher education and private sector clients, in March 2010, were The University of Chicago and Hobsons.

Reaching new heights

A capstone is a high point. Our mission is to help clients tap their potential and make a lasting difference for individuals, organisations and society: to do well, and to do good.

How we advise students

We match each student's background, interests, finances and goals with suitable colleges and universities, and with boarding schools at secondary level. We work only with regionally accredited U.S. institutions and officially accredited schools in other countries, and we explain our services and fees in full.

title: Vision, mission and values
summary: What we aim for and how we work.
bodyHtml:
Vision

To be the leading human resource development company in Vietnam, recognised for creative education and training solutions and excellent service.

Mission

To create opportunities that help individuals and institutions succeed: helping people reach their study and career ambitions, helping institutions carry out their international education plans in Vietnam and abroad, and making a lasting, positive difference.

Values

  • Integrity. The highest ethical standards in everything we do; openness is both right and good business.
  • Learning. Continuous personal, academic and professional growth, and listening to client feedback.
  • Global awareness. Helping clients build international and cultural perspectives.
  • Innovation. Staying adaptable and willing to reinvent ourselves.
  • Results. Caring as much about the outcome as the process, at every stage.

title: Why Capstone
bodyHtml:
Quality pledge

We aim to benefit everyone we serve, from individuals to institutions. A commitment to excellence and superior service helps our clients succeed personally, academically and professionally.

Bilingual, bicultural, experienced

Our founder and staff hold advanced degrees from U.S. universities and have decades of senior experience in higher education, non-profit and private sectors in the United States, Germany and Vietnam.
